stories.title: Show HN: CRSS v0.1 – a primitive for sharing agent memory and behavior
stories.summary: cRSS enables Agents to have shared memory (Agent B knows your preferences because you told Agent A) or to share behavior. (Agent B adopts behavioral characteristics of Agent A).Not a library, framework, nor storage system.cRSS is a primitive.cRSS turns LLM context mutation into structured, deterministic, auditable event feed (like RSS + event sourcing + git-like diffs), so multiple agents can share, replay, audit, and deterministically reconstruct what went into each model inference. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47473767 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
